request.subject: UNIT:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Remove the shield and the spear completely. He stands with a huge two-handed greatsword point-down in front of him, blade between his feet, both gauntlets on the gold crossguard; a short crimson tabard with a gold cross over full steel plate. The kettle helmet becomes a closed steel great helm with a dark eye slit, gold band and tall crimson plume. Keep proportions, big head, pauldrons, feet, outline and style the same, transparent background. Sun at the bottom left.
